items.title: ANS-256: KJ7DZ sweeps the AMSAT awards ladder in one go
items.blurb: Today’s AMSAT News Service notes Frank Hoonhaut, KJ7DZ, claimed five awards in a single submission — Communicators’ Club through Oscar Century #64 plus the South Africa Satellite Achievement Award. Bruce Paige KK5DO says that is the full AMSAT operating ladder at once; Frank already holds GridMaster #66. Rules live at amsat.org/awards.

items.title: Isar Aerospace puts SpaceTeamSat1 and FramSat-1 into orbit
items.blurb: ANS-256: Isar’s second flight from Andøya on 5 September deployed two IARU-coordinated CubeSats. SpaceTeamSat1 (TU Wien) downlinks on 437.395 MHz with student-upload modes; FramSat-1 (Orbit NTNU) uses 435.141 MHz AX.25 G3RUH at 9600 bps. Both sit near 500 km sun-synchronous — listen while they are new.

items.title: RI1FJZ closes on Alexandra Land; island ops eyed from 14 September
items.blurb: DX-World’s 13 September note: Apostol Andrey is in thick fog near Franz Josef Land and the team cannot see much, after crossing 80°N — Vasily RA1ZZ’s 45th birthday aboard. A 0600Z tracker fix put them near 79°32′N 45°41′E at 5.2 knots. The expedition site now lists the island window as 14–29 September; watch for the first RI1FJZ spots after landfall.

items.title: YM7KK/0 is QRV from Giresun Island (AS-154) through 15 September
items.blurb: Golkem TA7AZC and Emre TA7EK of GITRAD activate Giresun Island today through 15 September as YM7KK/0 for IOTA AS-154, plus WCA TA-00101, WWFF TAFF-0208, and POTA TR-0328. Fully portable on batteries and portable antennas — no shore power or water. QSL direct and LoTW; a July attempt was weather-scrubbed.

items.title: KH8WW Aunuʻu: on-scene antenna pics; 80 m due tomorrow
items.blurb: Yuris YL2GM sent DX-World fresh photos of the KH8WW antennas on Aunuʻu (OC-045). The 80 m antenna is planned for 14 September local; the station remains QRV through 24 September on CW, SSB, and FT8. Clusters already show solid Asia/Pacific pileups — listen while the path is open.

items.title: VE3YTX overbuilds handmade stamped QSL cards for first CW POTA QSOs
items.blurb: Josh VE3YTX’s 13 September QRPer piece: after thanking his first slow-CW POTA hunters by email, he rat-holed into 3D-printed stamp molds, silicone rubber, and alignment jigs for vintage-feel cards. First finished card went to Becky N4BKY of Ham Radio Duo after a park contact that night. Bureau TBD — if you are in those early logs, a stamped card is coming.

items.title: Activate All RI final day: chase Rhode Island parks through 1800 EDT
items.blurb: Day three of Activate All RI wraps at 1800 EDT today after putting the state’s 61 POTA references on the air since Friday. Hunters still chasing Worked All RI should use the live RI spots feed and the hunted-parks import tool on ripota.org. More activations are welcome even at parks already scheduled — last window of the weekend.

items.title: X: ARRL pushes membership as spectrum defense
items.blurb: ARRL posted this morning that protecting the bands takes strength in numbers, quoting member Henry KE0ON on membership as spectrum defense. Useful Sunday reminder alongside the September VHF Contest still running through 0259 UTC Monday and Route 66 On The Air through 20 September.
